response.rationale: These are two different concepts. A, the Hive Owner, is the person or beekeeper who owns a hive. TreatmentService refers to it through the owner reference in `hive.ownerId !== ownerId`, an ownership check made in src/business/treatmentService.ts (TreatmentService, node 2912145e8ad12343). B is the Hive itself, the physical colony. TreatmentRepository uses it as a lookup key in `findByHive(hiveId: string): Treatment[]` in src/persistence/repositories.ts (node b2566037ba6b6900). A hive has an owner, so the two are linked by a relationship, but they are not one concept under two names. Sharing an id-style attribute does not make them the same.
